title: Bounded dew/frost-point diagnostic and explicit unavailability

diagnostic.phase_policy: Preserve the computed diagnostic's default0C ice/water switch, including when an alternate process forward state uses0.01C. No new round-trip promise in that narrow interval.

statuses.dry_no_finite_point: pw equals zero; no finite dew/frost point
statuses.below_correlation_range: positive pw below the supported ice endpoint
statuses.above_correlation_range: pw above the supported water endpoint
statuses.phase_gap: between outer bounds but in neither phase pressure range
statuses.phase_overlap: pressure belongs to both phase ranges, if encountered

diagnostic.ordinary: Finite results carry no new status field.
endpoints: Membership is checked before endpoint conventions.
Unique membership and exact endpoint pressure equality returns-100,0 or200C as appropriate.
Ice upper pressure retains a legacy negative result when it lies in the selected branch; otherwise returns nextafter(0,-infinity), never water's zero.
diagnostic.inversion: Extract the unchanged70-midpoint loop. Retain its original[-80,150] calculation when the old pressure bracket contains the target and its result lies in the selected phase. Otherwise use the supported phase bracket.
diagnostic.limits: Rounded saturation pressure need not identify a unique binary64 temperature. No exact physical-root or one-ULP certificate.

changed: Computed dew/frost-point inversion and optional unavailable status
Remove the caller's independent dry-air-100C sentinel
Remove misleading 'exact' wording from the module description
unchanged: Wet-bulb signed inverse and explicit-input feasibility
Physical humidity, pressure, enthalpy, volume and saturation-degree arithmetic
Physical pass predicate and RH tolerance
scope.explicit_input_limit: Null computed output does not become a valid input. Extrapolated explicit dew-point input validation is separate and outside this change.

receiver.oracle: 80-digit Decimal Horner evaluation of the primary2017 coefficient equations and independently expressed pressure-to-humidity conversion. No producer helper imports or candidate-output oracle.
receiver.execution: All17 unclaimed states/processes and14 claims before the aggregate assertion. Preserve raw decisions and printable solver/strict-JSON errors.

evidence_classes.independent_pressure_inversions: W from independent pressure at-90C (Tdb20,P101325Pa) and170C (Tdb185,P5MPa), with pressure and temperature checks.
evidence_classes.round_trip: Explicit-90C input, pressure independently corroborated; public forward/inverse consistency.
evidence_classes.closed_endpoints: Explicit-100C, explicit0C and RH1 at200C/P5MPa have exact endpoint output/claim conventions.
evidence_classes.unavailable: Dry RH0/W0, positive W1e-16 below support, W from611.18Pa within the default phase gap, and pressure above pws200 within the existing W-branch RH tolerance.
evidence_classes.ordinary_controls: RH0.5 at20C, explicit frost-20C, explicit dew5C, ordinary RH-driven mixing and cooling.
evidence_classes.ice_upper: Explicit nextafter(0,-infinity); pressure corroborated against primary ice limit; returned point must be in[-1e-8,nextafter(0,-infinity)]. No uniquely determined floating temperature asserted.

receiver.above_range_control: Tdb200C/P5MPa with W from1.00001 times independent pws(200); explicitly require pws(200)<pw<1.0001*pws(200). This exercises the existing admission tolerance, not strict physical undersaturation or new real-fluid accuracy.

claims.extension_pairs: Each of the three extension/round-trip cases receives a truthful target and false old clipping endpoint; atol1e-8C,rtol0.
claims.endpoint_controls: The three closed endpoints receive exact matching claims with atol0,rtol0.
claims.null_controls: Five unavailable diagnostics receive a false old numeric value; gap uses0C with atol1e-8C to include the legacy bisection limit. Other null challenges use atol0. All rtol0.
claims.null_refusal: passed=False with reason, unchanged null/status, and no claim_check; finite mismatches use the existing scalar comparison.

inherited_wet.requirement: All requests/order/assertions and existing whole/projection hashes are retained. Stock full hashes must equal the original landed wet candidate. Across the new pair, all32 new non-dew hashes and all remaining row fields must match except the two original hash fields whose dew diagnostic may intentionally change; the wet bracket remains in the new digest.

preservation.gates: Every maintained CI and actual-tool gate. No workflow edits.

registered_pi.temperatures: All Tdb20C/P101325Pa. The truthful-90C claim uses1e-8C absolute tolerance. All false numeric claims use zero tolerance.
registered_pi.delivery: Actual registered tool.execute with all requests batched before assertions, dedicated unittest wrapper and eight parameterized pytest cases. No JS changes or null inputs.

first_execution: After this protocol, source, both receiver additions, reporting-only inherited receiver and README/heads are frozen and preregistered, run the first maintained PR stock/candidate pair. No local numerical execution or after-output retuning.
receipt: Preserve both original complete CI logs once; verify actual checkout trees and source blobs, scoped preservation and the exact landed tree. Any concurrent main change needs explicit combined qualification.

primary_sources.title: ASHRAE Fundamentals2017 SI Chapter1 equations5/6
primary_sources.interpretation: Documented support of the actual ice/liquid coefficients in this source; do not substitute the different2025 correlation. All returned temperatures remain approximate model inversions.

claim_limit: Maintained source qualification only. No new model/contest score, timing comparison, universal phase round-trip, exact transcendental arithmetic or exact thermodynamic-root certificate.
